findings.issue: כִּי is only marked as a conjunction; «porque» selects the causal sense.
Unmarked supplied copula. The clause is verbless (negative + noun + preposition); a copula that only makes it a sentence must be asterisk-marked.
Niphal imperfect 3ms is fixed as Spanish future; the imperfect does not itself mark future time.
Common noun אֵל (H410, HNcmsa) is left untranslated as El, with title capitalization. A non-name deity noun is Spanish Dios.

notes: Jacob, Israel, the two ב, both ל, niphal אמר, מה, and qal perfect פעל otherwise match the tokens; HRd licenses el on tiempo.
